verdict.rationale: Gitleaks supports custom detection rules (including composite rules with primary/auxiliary conditions) and can be wired into event-driven automation: a pre-commit hook that fails a commit when a rule matches, and gitleaks-action which scans on PR/push events and automatically comments on PRs or alerts specified GitHub accounts. This covers rule-defined, event-triggered actions but only within fixed integration points (git hooks, GitHub Actions) rather than a general-purpose rule/automation engine. Missing for 10: a flexible event/webhook automation framework, support for arbitrary trigger conditions beyond git hooks/CI, and any AI-native orchestration capability.
